item.title: [−3] Meghalaya Records 85 Per Cent Rainfall Deficit In October: IMD
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 6 reports from Daily Pioneer, rajasthan.economictimes.indiatimes.com, Moneycontrol.com and 3 more. Related: “Rabi sowing down 46% from last year; oilseeds, pulses acreage plunges amid rain deficit”. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: strong headwind (−3) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] A bigger pour: India's bulk Scotch imports from UK soar nearly 1,000% after trade deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 13 reports from DD News, The Drinks Business, BW Businessworld and 10 more. Related: “No GM, no non-veg milk, says India's trade minister ahead of US trade deal”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 30 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] India Sees Qatar LNG Supply Cut After Iran Strike - Energy News, Top Headlines, Commentaries, Features & Events
item.description:
Signal: higher gas prices. 2 reports from EnergyNow.com, Urban Acres. Related: “Petronet LNG Seeks US Gas Route as Qatar Supply Risks Rise”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 30 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Fertiliser costs and subsidy rise

Why it matters: India imports about half its gas as LNG; dearer gas squeezes city-gas distributors, raises the fertiliser subsidy bill and lifts power and industrial fuel costs.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] India faces prolonged food inflation as weak monsoon pushes up prices of grains, chicken and milk
item.description:

Why it matters: Cooling food prices ease household budgets and open room for RBI rate cuts.
